main_text.p: mini, multisq; in locis,pulsis apiculis,fu-cos substituerunt: sed etiam in eos qui inuocant nomen Domini nostri IESV CHRISTI, saeviunt, anathematismis, proscriptionibus,& satyrica dicacitate?

Porrò, si Rempublicam spectes, an' ne inficias ibis, summos iuxta & inferiores gubernatores,maximis incommodis,ue luti secundae nauigationis remoris,uehe menter laborare? Siccine negabis, Dy-naftas non paucos usque adeò ebrios esse voluptatibus: ac παροξυσμοῖς [?], ut aleae,ue-nationibus, non necessarijs μεγάλης φαυ- ταολοῖς [?] negocijs, adeò immersos, ut vixil-lis vacet alienis oculis cernere,alienis au-ribus audire,alienis manibus aliquid ag-gredi? Quàm multi boni & patriae amant-issimi Politarchae,habent collegas ἐπισκόποις [?],qui etiam optimis consilijs refragatur, non aliam ob causfam, quàm quòd domi suae non esse nata uideant? Quoties & quàm multis in locis, turbuleti & uagabundi ἀλλοτριεπίσκοποι [?], qui interim nuncios pacis sese esse fingunt,ubi percuniculos irrepserunt in alienas sedes,turbas maximas dant Politicis gubernatoribus,Verbi diuini Ministris,& bene cofti-

page.notes: The page number is printed as "33" at the top right. The Greek words are copied as far as they can be read; each is marked [?] because the scan is faint and the letters are uncertain. The word "percuniculos" is written whole because no hyphen is printed at the line break. The first line of the page is a fragment continuing from the previous page.
